prompt: With arm_a: if p1 and p2 are both on conveyor_in when the job starts, move p1 to station1. Otherwise move p3 from conveyor_in to station1.

paths.when: object_at p1 conveyor_in and object_at p2 conveyor_in
not (object_at p1 conveyor_in and object_at p2 conveyor_in)

why: The request needs a choice made at run time from the state of the world. RoboLang 1.3 has no if/else: `pre` only stops a run, and a goal states one fixed end state. RoboLang 1.4 (decision 0027) expresses it with `if`.
